title: Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.20606v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in robot learning have driven rapid progress in humanoid control, enabling increasingly agile behaviors in the real world. However, humanoid control networks are typically obtained through conventional training procedures, while comparatively little attention has been given to directly modeling the distribution of their learned weights and generating functional networks in weight space. In this work, we investigate whether high-performing humanoid control networks can be generatively modeled directly through their weights. We adopt a latent diffusion framework that couples a linear autoencoder with a Diffusion Transformer. The autoencoder compresses actor network parameters into a compact latent space, and the Diffusion Transformer models the distribution of these latents. translated_title: 基于扩散模型的人形机器人策略神经权重建模与理解
translated_abstract: 机器人学习领域的最新进展推动了人形机器人控制的快速发展，使其能够在现实世界中实现越来越敏捷的行为。然而，人形机器人控制网络通常是通过传统训练流程获得的，而针对直接建模其学习到的权重分布、并在权重空间中生成功能性网络的研究却相对较少。在这项工作中，我们研究了能否通过权重对高性能的人形机器人控制网络进行直接的生成式建模。我们采用了一个潜在扩散框架，将线性自编码器与扩散Transformer相结合：自编码器将执行器网络参数压缩到紧凑的潜在空间中，扩散Transformer则对这些潜在表示的分布进行建模。通过在为Unitree G1机器人收集的强化学习网络数据上进行训练，我们的方法能够生成可部署的网络，执行各种运动技能。
tldr: 该论文提出一种将线性自编码器与扩散Transformer相结合的潜在扩散框架，可直接在权重空间中对强化学习得到的人形机器人控制网络进行生成式建模，从而生成可部署的高性能控制网络。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a latent diffusion framework coupling a linear autoencoder with a Diffusion Transformer to generatively model the weights of reinforcement-learned humanoid control networks, enabling the direct generation of deployable, high-performing control policies in weight space.
